scope: Prior-driven counterfactual discrimination probes for the missing-extinction candidates (plan Step 5). Each candidate's literature AOD550 enters as an extra extinction column (or, for negative-Angstrom mineral transported, a validation-side spectral factor) on top of the committed fixed_opac default, evaluated through the same kernel adapters as the height statistics; a zero-AOD probe restores the baseline exactly (pytest). Fixed priors only: nothing is fitted, nothing becomes a default, and no causal attribution is made - the product ranks prior-order compatibility only, per docs/ROUND2.md discipline.
variant_scope: Probes run on the fixed_opac variant only: the candidates are missing components on top of the committed default physics; probing the molecular variant would conflate the free-troposphere candidate with the boundary-layer ones.

verdict_bands.brightness_semantics: gap_closure_fraction = fraction of the event's committed log-residual closed by the probe (1 = exactly closes)
verdict_bands.shape_semantics: disagreement_closed_fraction = movement of the shape metric toward unity; negative = pushed further away
verdict_bands.compatible: closure in [0.5, 2]: prior-order effect of the residual's order
verdict_bands.tension: closure in [0.1, 0.5) or (2, 10]: right direction, magnitude off
verdict_bands.excluded_leaning: closure < 0.1 (negligible at prior level) or > 10 (dominant at prior level); for shape, < 0.1 also covers worsening
verdict_bands.ranking_key: brightness-axis minimum gap closure across the four events (weakest link), descending; shape verdicts are recorded per event alongside and enter the owner's reading, not this mechanical key

not_probed.reason: The free troposphere is tabulated at 50% RH only and humidified scaling needs the per-component OPAC data files, marked unavailable in prior_parameters.json (search trail there); no sourced prior AOD exists, so no probe runs and the candidate carries no verdict.
not_probed.direction_support: The 677 nm same-event calibration direction supports 'more same-type extinction' (docs/ROUND2.md), but that calibrated value is not a prior and is excluded from this ranking.
